Photo 2 shows the dryer from above, with the dome and stand clearly visible. The dome has a vented top with a grey handle. The base has two circular openings, likely for water or steam, and a small vent. The power cord is visible on the left side.
All photos show the dryer in a clean, well-lit environment, with no visible damage or wear. The cord appears intact and unbroken.
